newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold's Bompreco in SuperMar buy.
newsitem.headline: Ahold's Bompreco in SuperMar buy.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Koninklijke Ahold NV said on Tuesday its 50 percent owned Brazilian unit Bompreco SA Supermercados do Nordeste had agreed to buy a controlling interest in the voting stock of SuperMar Supermercados SA in Brazil.

The stake in SuperMar will be bought from Panda SA, Ahold said without disclosing financial details of the transaction. After completion, Bompreco expects to announce a tender offer to acquire the remaining SuperMar shares, it added.
SuperMar is a chain of 45 supermarkets, three hypermarkets and two discount department stores in the northeastern state of Bahia. The firm posted 1996 sales of $645 million.

Ahold said the acquisition would strengthen Bompreco's position in the northeast of Brazil and will increase its food retail sales to more than two billion dollars, ranking it as the country's third largest supermarkets group.
Bompreco now operates 39 supermarkets, eight hypermarkets and three department stores in the north and northeast of Brazil. The company also owns a consumer credit subsidiary.
Final terms of the SuperMar acquisition will be set after completion of a due diligence, Ahold said.
